# EMET — Gospel of Mary, Chapter 8
**Agent:** EMET (Literal/Transparent)
**Source:** P.Berol. 8502, Gospel of Mary, p. 11-14 | Coptic
**Chapter:** 8

---

[Pages 11-14 of the manuscript are lost. Chapter 8 falls entirely within this second lacuna. This section contained the continuation of Mary's vision report — specifically the soul's ascent through the cosmic powers. The Greek fragments P.Oxy 3525 and P.Ryl. 463 do not cover this section. No text survives.]

---

*Translator's Note (EMET):* The second major lacuna. The soul's encounter with the first and second powers (Darkness and Desire, in most reconstructions) would have been narrated here based on what follows in chapter 10.
